text:
I love him with blood, with bone,

with the seeing eye and breath,

with the brow that bends thought down,

with this hot, imprisoned heart;


with the fatally obsessive dream

of this love that fills all feeling,

from the brief laugh to the lament,

from the bewitched wound to its kiss.


My life pays tribute to his life,

whether it seems tumultuous or solitary,

like one desperate flower.


It depends upon him as the orchid

on the hard branch, or ivy on the wall,

lifted, breathing only there.

translation.title: Like One Desperate Flower
translation.editorial_note: The bodily litany remains forceful; tributaria keeps the unequal economy of devotion.
